import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
import os
import re
import sys

np.random.seed(42)

# Load data from correct paths
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Loaded train: {len(train_df)} rows, test: {len(test_df)} rows")

# Prepare training labels and texts
texts = train_df["text"].values
labels = train_df["author"].values

# Label mapping
label_to_idx = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
idx_to_label = {v: k for k, v in label_to_idx.items()}
numeric_labels = [label_to_idx[label] for label in labels]


# Apply preprocessing to all texts consistently
def preprocess_text(text):
    """Preprocess text: lowercase, strip all punctuation, normalize whitespace."""
    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Strip all punctuation characters (keeping only alphanumeric and spaces)
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", "", text)
    # Normalize whitespace
    text = " ".join(text.split())
    return text


preprocessed_texts_train = [preprocess_text(t) for t in texts]
preprocessed_texts_test = [preprocess_text(t) for t in test_df["text"].values]

# Fit vectorizer on preprocessed training texts
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 1), min_df=3, max_df=0.8, sublinear_tf=True
)
X_train_full = vectorizer.fit_transform(preprocessed_texts_train)

# First split: train/validation (properly hold out for validation)
X_train_val, X_test_holdout, y_train_val, y_test_holdout = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    numeric_labels,
    test_size=0.15,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=numeric_labels,
)

print(f"Train split: {X_train_val.shape[0]}, Val split: {X_test_holdout.shape[0]}")

# Train logistic regression with grid search over C values
param_grid = {"C": [0.5, 1.0, 2.0, 5.0, 10.0]}
grid_search = GridSearchCV(
    LogisticRegression(
        max_iter=1000,
        class_weight="balanced",
        random_state=42,
        multi_class="multinomial",
    ),
    param_grid,
    cv=3,
    scoring="neg_multiclass_logloss",
)
grid_search.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)

print(f"Best C value: {grid_search.best_params_['C']}")

best_model = grid_search.best_estimator_


# Function to calculate multi-class log loss given one-hot encoded labels and predicted probabilities
def calc_multiclass_logloss(true_labels_onehot, probs):
    """Calculate multi-class log loss: -(1/N) * sum_i sum_j (y_ij * log(p_ij))"""
    eps = 1e-15
    probs_clipped = np.clip(probs, eps, 1 - eps)
    loss = -np.mean(np.sum(true_labels_onehot * np.log(probs_clipped), axis=1))
    return loss


# Convert numeric labels to one-hot for validation
num_classes = len(label_to_idx)
y_test_holdout_onehot = np.eye(num_classes)[y_test_holdout]

# Compute validation log loss on hold-out set (never used in training)
val_probs = best_model.predict_proba(X_test_holdout)
validation_loss = calc_multiclass_logloss(y_test_holdout_onehot, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {validation_loss:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_vectorized = vectorizer.transform(preprocessed_texts_test)
test_probs = best_model.predict_proba(test_vectorized)

# Ensure correct column order for submission
column_order = ["id", "EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Normalize each row so probabilities sum to 1 (as specified in competition rules)
row_sums = test_probs.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True)
row_sums_clipped = np.clip(row_sums, 1e-15, None)
normalized_probs = test_probs / row_sums_clipped

# Clip probabilities to valid range
submission_eap = normalized_probs[:, 0].clip(1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
submission_hpl = normalized_probs[:, 1].clip(1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)
submission_mws = normalized_probs[:, 2].clip(1e-15, 1 - 1e-15)

# Create submission DataFrame
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": sample_submission["id"].values,
        "EAP": submission_eap,
        "HPL": submission_hpl,
        "MWS": submission_mws,
    }
)

# Save to required location
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Final Validation Multi-class Log Loss: {validation_loss:.6f}")
